flowContents.name: Final lab - End-to-end pipeline
flowContents.comments: logs.raw -> validate-transform -> deliver (Kafka logs.clean) -> errors (logs.dlq). Load: make lab-final-load n=100000. Reconciliation: Counters final.* (accepted = delivered + filtered.debug + dlq)

processors.name: ConsumeKafka
processors.comments: In a cluster it runs on all nodes: the 6 logs.raw partitions are split among them

processors.name: error.stage=ingest-parse
processors.comments: Kafka messages the Record Reader could not parse

processors.name: UpdateRecord
processors.comments: Writer LogEvent.out: ingest_ts first, user.pwd dropped

processGroups.name: deliver
processGroups.comments: PublishKafka (logs.clean) with RetryFlowFile; final.delivered after success

processors.name: UpdateCounter
processors.comments: After a successful publish: counts records that reached logs.clean

processors.name: PublishKafka (logs.clean)
processors.comments: Delivery. failure -> RetryFlowFile (the only retry; Penalty Duration 0 sec here). success -> final.delivered: the counter counts what Kafka accepted, not attempts.

processors.name: RetryFlowFile
processors.comments: 5 retries, 10 sec apart (Penalty Duration), then the DLQ: ~1 min after the destination stops accepting

controllerServices.name: kafka
controllerServices.comments: Kafka of the playground: PLAINTEXT, kafka1:19092 inside nifi-net

parameters.name: out.dir
parameters.description: Fallback DLQ sink (on the host: nifi/data/final)
